   323	 PROPOSED COMPLIANCE ORDER
   324	Pursuant to 49 United States Code § 60118, the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety
   325	Administration (PHMSA) proposes to issue to Tallgrass a Compliance Order incorporating the
   326	following remedial requirements to ensure the compliance of Tallgrass with the pipeline safety
   327	regulations:
   328	A.
   329	
   330	In regard to Item number 3 of the Notice pertaining to Tallgrass’s failure to
   331	properly identify and implement safety related points in the SCADA database,
   332	Tallgrass must identify, though procedure, which points are safety related and
   333	which alarms are safety related. In the SCADA master database, Tallgrass must
   334	implement the designation of these points as safety related within 90 days of
   335	receipt of the Final Order.
   336	
   337	B.
   338	
   339	In regard to Item number 4 of the Notice pertaining to Tallgrass’ failure to
   340	provide records that demonstrated compliance with identifying at least once each
   341	calendar month points affecting safety that have been taken off scan in the
   342	SCADA host, have had alarms inhibited, generated false alarms, or that have had
   343	forced or manual values for periods of time exceeding that required for associated
   344	maintenance or operating activities, Tallgrass must amend its procedure to include
   345	a report that provides both the date and time the point was placed in the associated
   346	state and when it was removed. It also needs to include a requirement to review
   347	SCADA logs, MOC documents and the like to determine and document the
   348	reason for the action, the length of time the point was in the associated state and if
   349	the time period exceeded the period that was required for associated maintenance
   350	or operating activities. The procedure also needs to include the requirement to
   351	document the date and individual(s) completing the review. The SCADA master
   352	database needs to be reviewed to address the points that have been designed but
   353	not integrated to the field as well as the historical points. The monthly report
   354	should either not include these items or they can be filtered to allow reviewers to
   355	only look at the relevant information. Tallgrass must amend its procedure and
   356	carry out this SCADA review and provide evidence to PHMSA of the data base
   357	and monthly reports within 60 days of receipt of the Final Order.
   358	
   359	C.
   360	
   361	In regard to Item number 5 of the Notice pertaining to Tallgrass’ failure to
   362	provide a procedure to verify the correct safety-related alarm set-point values and
   363	alarm descriptions at least once each calendar year, but at intervals not to exceed
   364	15 months, Tallgrass must amend its procedure to detail the process it employs for
   365	the annual review of safety-related alarm set-point values and alarm descriptions.
   366	The procedure needs to include how identified deficiencies will be documented
   367	and resolved as well as how this review will be documented, and how records will
   368	be preserved for inspection. Additionally, the operator needs to conduct a
   369	verification using the amended procedure to verify the correct safety-related alarm
   370	set-point values and alarm descriptions. Tallgrass must amend its procedure and
   371	conduct this verification within 60 days of receipt of the Final Order.
   372	9
   373	
   374	 D.
   375	
   376	In regard to Item number 6 of the Notice pertaining to Tallgrass’ failure to
   377	provide detailed records that demonstrated compliance with reviewing their alarm
   378	management plan at least once each calendar year, but at intervals not exceeding
   379	15 months to determine the effectiveness of the plan, Tallgrass must amend its
   380	procedure to detail the documentation of the topics that will be included in the
   381	annual review of the Alarm Management Plan. Tallgrass must clarify what will be
   382	included in the review to coordinate what Table 14 states in comparison to the
   383	procedure. A review must be conducted using the amended procedure and
   384	documentation process within 60 days of receipt of the Final Order.
   385	
   386	E.
   387	
   388	It is requested that Tallgrass maintain documentation of the safety improvement
   389	costs associated with fulfilling this Compliance Order and submit the total to
   390	Gregory Ochs, Director, Central Region, Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety
   391	Administration, OPS. It is requested that these costs be reported in two
   392	categories: 1) total cost associated with preparation/revision of plans, procedures,
   393	studies and analyses, and 2) total cost associated with replacements, additions and
   394	other changes to pipeline infrastructure.
